components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:

## What changed

Telephone numbers are now stored and returned in **E.164 form** instead of a bare 10-digit string, and duplicate detection compares the E.164 values.

**New helper — `TelephoneE164`** (`rest/function/owner/TelephoneE164.java`)
The single source of the normalization rule:
- strips spaces, dashes and brackets;
- keeps a leading `+` and country code when present; otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits;
- requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, else throws `InvalidTelephoneException` (→ 400).

So `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`, and `12` is rejected.

**`ValidateNewOwner`** — replaced the "strip to exactly 10 digits" logic with `TelephoneE164.normalize(...)`, storing the E.164 value back on the request.

**`CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique`** — now compares the request's (already-E.164) telephone against each stored owner's telephone normalized to E.164, so duplicates are detected by E.164 equality.

**Supporting updates so the new form is accepted end-to-end:**
- `Owner` entity: bean-validation constraint changed from `^[0-9]{10}$` (+`@Digits`) to `^\+[0-9]{8,15}$` — otherwise the E.164 value failed on JPA flush with a 500.
- `openapi.yml`: telephone `pattern`/`example` updated to E.164 (the DTO is generated from this).
- Seed data (`db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/data.sql`): the NANP seed numbers converted to `+1…` E.164 so existing rows satisfy the new constraint.
- `InvalidTelephoneException` message updated to describe the E.164 rule.
